RollDice(IRandomNumberGenerator, int, int)

Uses an IRandomNumberGenerator to simulate rolling dice.

public static int RollDice(this IRandomNumberGenerator rng, int numberOfDice = 2, int sidesOfDie = 6)

Parameters

rng IRandomNumberGenerator

The IRandomNumberGenerator to use for dice rolling.

The number of dice to roll. Assumes 2 if not specified.

The number of sides on each die. Assumes 6 if not specified.

A random total from rolling numberOfDice dice with sidesOfDie sides.
